name: cf-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this Central African Republic corporate tax Guide for 2026 research on companies, agricultural businesses and the ordinary profit-versus-minimum-tax calculation. It maps territorial profits, carryforward losses, instalments, annual results and the new fiscal visa attached to statistical and fiscal declarations. Match IS, impôt minimum forfaitaire, DSF, ONECCA, tax certification, company profit and agricultural company queries. The ordinary computation is expressly a baseline from the Ministry’s official 2023 code; the signed 2026 law supplies the separate reporting amendment. It is a partial research draft with unresolved consolidation and procedure questions, not an accountant attestation or a filing-ready return.
